internationalResults.illustrationBoundary: All frames are explicit design-state illustrations. No current numeric market fixture or qualified live reading is claimed. Supported price/breadth with missing risk is a constructed qualification case.

qualificationRequirements.recoveryNotApplicable: Qualified, recognized, known primary state outside recovery for the selected identity/snapshot. Empty assessment object alone is insufficient.
qualificationRequirements.recoveryUnavailable: Primary state missing, malformed or unqualified, or assessment absent.
qualificationRequirements.recoveryPartial: Qualified primary recovery with incomplete supporting evidence. Missing risk never becomes benign/clear risk.
qualificationRequirements.riskUnavailable: Missing ledger, failed read, unresolved identity or insufficient source qualification.
qualificationRequirements.riskAccruing: Successfully read qualified ledger contains recorded observations and no mature outcomes yet. Scorecard grant_reason=accruing alone is insufficient.
qualificationRequirements.riskEmptyWarnings: Successful qualified query proves selected-period coverage and no alert rows, including immature rows. n_alerts counts graded alerts and cannot establish this.
qualificationRequirements.riskPendingWarningOutcomes: Mature observations may exist while recorded warning rows remain ungraded; needs distinct no-warning-outcomes-yet treatment, not no-recorded-warnings.
qualificationRequirements.correlationInsufficient: A qualified reason establishes insufficient overlapping return history; null/missing binding alone does not prove this.
qualificationRequirements.linksEmpty: Successful rights-qualified documented-relationship query has no matching records in the available sources; no global no-exposure conclusion.
qualificationRequirements.linksRestricted: Rights qualification permits only the shown request context/metadata, with no unauthorized relationship records.
